A laboratory setup for the preparation of oxygen. A hard glass test tube containing a black-and-white mixture of KClO3 and MnO2 is clamped on a retort stand and heated with a Bunsen burner. A delivery tube leads from a stopper in the test tube into a trough of water, bubbling gas into an inverted gas jar filled with water. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A flowchart block diagram of a town water treatment plant. Arrows lead from a "Reservoir" to an "Aeration spray", then to a mixing tank, moving into a large "Sedimentation tank" where sludge settles to the bottom. The water then flows into a "Sand filter bed", followed by a smaller tank. Finally, an arrow points to a "Storage tower" and then to "Homes".

A flow diagram of the Contact Process. Block 1: "Sulphur Burner" (S + O2 -> SO2). Block 2: "Purifier". Block 3: "Catalyst Chamber (V2O5, 450 °C)" showing 2SO2 + O2 -> 2SO3. Block 4: "Absorption Tower" where conc. H2SO4 falls from the top to absorb SO3, forming Oleum. Block 5: "Dilution Tank" where water is added to Oleum to output Conc. H2SO4.
